title: Practical AI Learning for Caregivers at Carebom
summary: A volunteer training session introduced caregivers to everyday AI tools while emphasizing privacy and human verification.

sources.label: Read Chorong Park's original LinkedIn post

paragraphs.text: Chorong Park led a two-hour volunteer training session at the Carebom Caregiver Training Institute, sharing an account of the experience on December 19, 2025. The session introduced caregivers working with older adults to practical uses of generative AI.

Rather than rushing through a demonstration, Park described a step-by-step format with breaks and time to practice. Participants explored tools such as ChatGPT and Gemini for preparing questions and organizing communication around everyday caregiving tasks.

An important boundary ran through the training: AI-generated material needs to be checked. Park emphasized protecting personal information and treating generated responses as drafts, not as medical decisions or replacements for professional guidance.

Her reflection describes the value of meeting learners at their own pace and connecting unfamiliar tools to familiar responsibilities. She also expressed interest in offering further caregiver training in Korean and English.
